map.不能。增值预期是价格趋势判断，还要扣除持有成本（利息、税费、物业）和流动性折损，: No. An appreciation forecast is a call on price trend; holding costs (interest, taxes, property management) and liquidity discounts still have to come off, so the true annualized return is usually below the nominal gain.
